in_tamil.name: காந்த
in_tamil.meaning: கண் அல்லது காண் விழி (eye, to see)
in_tamil.long_meaning: காண் விழி (eye) or கண் (eye) - This name could be derived from the Sanskrit word कान्थ (कान्थश्च काण्) which means purification or cleansing. It could also be derived from the Tamil word காந்த which means eye.

in_marathi.name: Kanth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kantha', meaning 'bond'. This name signifies a strong and unbreakable bond between individuals, as well as a strong and unbreakable bond between an individual and the divine.

This name signifies a strong and unbreakable bond between individuals, as well as a strong and unbreakable bond between an individual and the divine.
